identifier: Edmund Optics product page 'Nikon Type F Non-Fluorescing 30ml PCB Free Immersion Oil', reached at the URL the person gave for stock number 57189; the page as served shows 'Stock #75-384'. Its Specifications block: Manufacturer Nikon; Index of Refraction (nd) 1.518; Abbe Number (vd) 41; Operating Temperature (degC) 23.
how_it_was_read: A plain HTTP client was refused (HTTP 403 at 2026-10-15, 5637 bytes, sha256 3a5dd2c0b342dbf0df56cf5bf889e187970a76fdc973b69bdfa6ea06cdbcf2d4), so the page was opened in the session's own browser pane, the ordinary way a person opens it, and read as page text, not through a summarising reader. The body text read had sha256 1636ac8bcf9cc080ea95a1beda4fd0983e736c322396b8cd1017908f98c58bd5 (9859 characters, 2026-10-15T18:02:56Z). Not held here: a commercial page with prices and stock counts that changes without notice, so the hash says what was read and not that it still reads that way.
grade_rule: E3, grade_tag vendor_spec: a supplier's published specification for the product type, not a measurement taken here. A RESELLER, NOT THE MANUFACTURER. The page names Nikon as manufacturer and does not say where its figures come from.
manufacturer_searched_first: task 046 asks for Nikon's own sheet first. Searched 2026-10-15 and none was found that states Type F's index: (1) https://www.microscope.healthcare.nikon.com/en_EU/products/accessories/immersion-oil/specifications (HTTP 200, sha256 dae99e0d8e8a5f545361d68db2b6e77a8ad3afe110fe443cf21e4d05de627bd3) tabulates viscosity, odour and application for Types N, B, F and silicone and gives no index; its one download is a cleaning brochure. (2) https://www.microscope.healthcare.nikon.com/products/accessories/immersion-oil (HTTP 200, sha256 706e109000e22bd6010ca5909ea59da0fc490f4c21d6fcdc7c3e528e20b4d97c) gives an index only for the silicone oil. (3) Nikon's safety data sheet for Type F, product code MXA22168, https://d33b8x22mym97j.cloudfront.net/phase4/literature/SDS/en_AMS/immersion_oil_type_f_us_3.pdf (HTTP 200, sha256 44e1852581147ca649766ff6b5cb3a9652cc909e170187f3c4299380de990375, 8 pages, issued 2016-08-10): section 9 lists no refractive index. A search restricted to Nikon's domains found nothing further.
wavelength_is_read_from_the_subscript: The page prints 'nd' and 'vd' and no wavelength in figures. The subscript d names the helium d line, 587.6 nm, by the standard optical convention, and that is what the entry's validity carries. That is a reading of notation, not a number the page prints, and the entry says so.
not_entered: (1) The Abbe number vd = 41: no dispersion quantity is registered in contracts/quantities.json, so it cannot be a numbers[] item; asked of manager-librarian, and it is kept here verbatim until then. (2) The page's prices, stock counts and the dimensions table of Nikon objectives that the page also carries, which is about lenses and not the oil. (3) The 'Certificate of Conformance: View' control, which is a viewer inside the reseller's page and not a Nikon document reached. (4) The page's own footer says some content 'may include material that has been generated or modified using artificial intelligence'; that is a reason this stays a reseller's E3 and is weighed against src_morrell_mxa22168_nikon_type_f_page, not a reason to enter nothing.
